# Coraine cases that test what only Coraine has (T-3549). One per line:
#   tag:<tag> <reason>            every case carrying the tag
#   name:<case> <reason>          one case (file name without .test)
#   tag@<store>:<tag> <reason>    only in the cell of that Antares store
# run.sh skips them (corTest --skip-tags / --skipNames); compare.py reports
# them as not-applicable with the reason. A case that starts the broker with
# a Coraine-only flag needs no line: antares.sh refuses the flag and
# compare.py files the case under that flag.
tag:bridge Coraine's southbound bridge plugins (loopback, MQTT, HTTP, DDS, Modbus); NGSI-LD defines no bridges
tag:channel Coraine's bridge channels
tag:goal Coraine's bridge goals
tag:plugins Coraine's plugin loader and API plugins
tag:dds the DDS bridge
tag:ddsSync the DDS store sync
tag:modbus the Modbus bridge
tag:mongoc Coraine's MongoDB store plugin
tag:corDB Coraine's corDB store plugin
tag:ramDB Coraine's ramDB store plugin
tag:cli Coraine's command line
tag:cor Coraine's cor:// transport
tag:admin Coraine's /admin API (Antares has its own admin API under another path and contract)
tag:metrics Coraine's metric names
tag:migrate the coraine-import migration tool
tag:upgrade Coraine's own upgrade path
tag:build compiling Coraine from source
tag:features Coraine's /build feature report
tag:version Coraine's /version and /build endpoints
tag:ha Coraine's MongoDB replica-set cache sync
tag:docker Coraine's container image
tag@memory:persistence the memory store keeps nothing across a restart by design
tag@memory:persist the memory store keeps nothing across a restart by design
tag@memory:restart the memory store keeps nothing across a restart by design
